source_refs.note: 3. Secretory/Post-Ovulatory Phase (Days 15-28): a main subheading of Female Reproductive Cycle - The Menstrual Cycle, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 80-82.

blocks.text: Ovulation ke baad LH phate hue Graafian follicle ko ek peeli (yellow) banawat mein badalta hai jise corpus luteum kehte hain. Corpus luteum estrogen aur progesterone hormones chhorta hai jo endometrium ko zyada khoon wala (vascular) aur glandular banate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein ek jagah “Copus luteum” chhapa hai; sahi naam corpus luteum hai.

blocks.title: For Information: menopause
blocks.text: Auraton mein taqreeban 50 saal ki umar mein menstrual cycle band ho jata hai; ise menopause kehte hain.

Agar fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam (degenerate) hona shuru ho jata hai. Kitab ke mutabiq is ke nateeje mein anterior pituitary LH chhorna band kar deta hai. Corpus luteum ke khatam hone se estrogen aur progesterone ki miqdar achanak gir jati hai. Is se moti endometrium khoon ke saath jhar jati hai, yani din 28 par menstruation hota hai (aur naya chakkar shuru hota hai).

blocks.title: For Information: hCG aur hamal ka test
blocks.text: Agar ovulate hua oocyte fertilize ho jaye to nanha embryo human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) chhorta hai. Yeh hormone corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai, is liye estrogen aur progesterone zyada rehte hain aur haiz nahin aata. hCG maa se nahin balke embryo ke chorion se aata hai, isi liye tamam pregnancy tests isi hormone ko check karte hain.

blocks.alt: Din 0 se 28 tak teen qataaron ka chart, menstrual phase, follicular phase, din 14 par ovulation aur secretory phase mein bata hua. Ovary: follicle barhta, ovulation par phat'ta, corpus luteum banta aur sukar jata hai. Hormones: FSH shuru mein barhta aur ovulation par chhota uchaal; estrogen ovulation se zara pehle aur phir din 21 ke qareeb uncha; LH din 13-14 par achanak uchaal; progesterone din 22 ke qareeb sab se ooncha. Endometrium: pehle dinon mein jharta, phir aakhir tak mota hota hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 17.7: Menstrual cycle (kitab ki Figure 17.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; 'Secretory' ki sahih spelling, menstrual phase din 5 tak).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ko oopar se neeche aik hi din par parhein: jaise din 14 par ovary mein follicle phat'ta hai, hormones mein LH ka uchaal hai aur endometrium mota ho raha hai. Kitab ki tasveer mein do ghaltiyan hain: aakhri hisse ka naam 'Secretary phase' chhapa hai, sahih 'Secretory phase' hai; aur menstrual phase ki lakeer din 4 par hai jabke kitab ka apna matn menstrual phase din 1 se 5 batata hai. Hamare khaake mein lakeer din 5 par hai. 'Follicular phase' ovary ka naam hai; rahim ke liye isi waqt ko proliferative phase kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Corpus luteum ka menstrual cycle mein kya kirdar hai, aur hamal mein ise kaun qaim rakhta hai?
blocks.explanation: Corpus luteum estrogen aur progesterone chhorta hai jo endometrium ko mota, khoon wala aur glandular rakhte hain. Fertilization na ho to yeh khatam ho jata hai aur haiz aata hai. Hamal mein embryo ka hCG ise qaim rakhta hai, is liye endometrium nahin jharti.

items: Din 1-5: menstrual phase, estrogen aur progesterone kam, endometrium ki functional layer jharti hai.
Din 6-14: FSH se Graafian follicle, estrogen se endometrium dobara moti; din 14 par LH ka achanak chhootna aur ovulation.
Din 15-28: LH se corpus luteum, estrogen aur progesterone; fertilization na ho to corpus luteum khatam, hormones girte hain aur din 28 par haiz.
Hamal mein embryo ka hCG corpus luteum ko qaim rakhta hai; taqreeban 50 saal par menopause.
